listing.name: Jet Force Gemini — JetForceGemini-Recomp (VibinToast)
listing.summary: Upstream claims full playability, modern controls and texture-pack support. Portcove has not completed a playthrough. This repository differs from the TK22 project and uses a DKR-derived runtime; their relationship and compatibility are not fully confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA z64 ROM, SHA-1 493ced9008dbe932d6e91179b68e8630cf23a023.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README for Windows or Linux archives, a Linux AppImage or a local source build. Select your own ROM in the player and keep saves for each package separately.
